parsed.draft_response:
Hi—thanks for flagging this. We understand your legal team is reviewing our DPA before you enable EU customer records, and they specifically need confirmation on (1) subprocessors, (2) data retention, and (3) whether support logs may include customer identifiers. 

We’ve got this marked for human review and will route it to the appropriate privacy/compliance contact to provide the needed clarification. 

To make sure the right details are returned, could you please share: (a) which DPA document/version your legal team is reviewing, and (b) the definition/scope of “support logs” in your request (e.g., which logs/data fields, and what counts as “customer identifiers” such as names, emails, or customer IDs)? If you already have a list of specific subprocessors or retention items that need confirmation, please include that as well.

Once we receive those details, we’ll ensure the privacy contact responds to your legal team as quickly as possible. In the meantime, EU customer record enabling may be delayed until the requested confirmations are provided.
promised_actions: Route the request to the appropriate privacy/compliance contact for human review

safety_notes: Do not promise a specific resolution, timeline, or that EU enabling will proceed—legal approval is a dependency.
Avoid confirming any specific DPA terms (subprocessors/retention/log contents) without the privacy contact’s review.
